candidates.topic: Four Planets Retrograde — Who Gets Hit Hardest
candidates.teaser: Four planets are retrograde right now — but only certain signs are taking the full force of all of them at once.
candidates.video_title: 4 Planets Retrograde — These Signs Feel It Most
candidates.video_description: Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde right now. Depending on your sign, you may be sitting at the center of this cosmic pressure.
candidates.script: Four planets are retrograde right now — Venus, Saturn, Uranus, Neptune — and that is not a coincidence you should scroll past. Scorpio is carrying Venus backward through its own sign. Aries has both Saturn and Neptune grinding in reverse at the same time. If your sun, moon, or rising falls in Scorpio or Aries, the pressure you are feeling right now has an astronomical reason behind it. This is the slowdown before the breakthrough.

candidates.topic: First Quarter Moon in Capricorn — Sun Square
candidates.teaser: The First Quarter Moon is forming a tense square with the Sun right now — and it's forcing a choice you've been avoiding.
candidates.video_title: First Quarter Moon Square Sun — Forced Decision
candidates.video_description: The Moon at 25° Capricorn squares the Sun at 25° Libra, creating classic First Quarter tension between ambition and balance. Something has to give.
candidates.script: The Moon in Capricorn is squaring the Sun in Libra right now — and that square is not gentle. In astrology, this First Quarter tension is considered a crisis of action. Capricorn wants results, structure, and a plan. Libra wants more time, more options, more fairness. At 25 degrees each, both are near the end of their stories. Whatever decision you have been weighing this week, the sky is telling you to stop stalling. Capricorn does not wait.

candidates.topic: Mars Conjunct Jupiter in Leo — What It Built (Lookback)
candidates.teaser: Mars and Jupiter just finished one of the rarest conjunctions of the decade — and what it built in your chart is still active.
candidates.video_title: Mars-Jupiter Leo Conjunction — What It Left Behind
candidates.video_description: Mars at 11° Leo and Jupiter at 22° Leo are still sharing the same sign, keeping the energy of their rare conjunction alive. Here's what that means for fixed signs.
candidates.script: Mars and Jupiter are both still in Leo — and in astrology, when the planet of drive and the planet of expansion share a sign, something gets amplified beyond what is comfortable. Whatever you started or declared between September and now, Leo energy does not let it shrink quietly. Fixed signs — Leo, Scorpio, Aquarius, Taurus — this conjunction rewrote something in your chart that is not reversing. The question is whether you are ready to own it.

candidates.topic: The Astrological 7th House — Partnerships and Open Enemies
candidates.teaser: The 7th house rules who you marry — but astrologers say it also rules something darker that most people never talk about.
candidates.video_title: The 7th House — Marriage AND Open Enemies
candidates.video_description: The 7th house in astrology governs committed partnerships, contracts, and — surprisingly — open enemies. It is the mirror your chart holds up to show you what you attract.
candidates.script: The 7th house rules marriage — but that is only half of what astrologers say about it. It also rules open enemies, the people who oppose you directly and by name. In traditional astrology, your partner and your rival sit in the same house because they serve the same function: they show you exactly who you are by being everything you are drawn to or repelled by. Whatever sign sits on your 7th house cusp describes both. So who keeps showing up in your life?
